children: A referendum is live on DOT DAO governance proposing dotUSD, a protocol-native stablecoin for Polkadot. The proposal outlines a phased rollout, starting with a stables-backed design and later moving to a DOT-collateralized vault phase, which remains subject to further development and governance approval.

The DOT-collateralized vault phase is the part with the largest economic consequence, since it would require DOT to be locked as backing and create structural collateral demand tied to stablecoin issuance. Approval would also expand DOT's token utility by adding a native settlement asset to the network's onchain economic flow.
The near-term effect stays limited to governance, because the collateralized phase depends on additional development and a separate governance decision before it can launch.
A referendum proposing dotUSD, a protocol-native stablecoin for Polkadot, is now live on DOT DAO governance.

title: Polkadot: dotUSD Stablecoin Referendum Goes Live on DOT DAO Governance - 10 Sep 2026
